# Natalia Maganda

> Web design and digital marketing agency specializing in SEO, Google Ads, and custom website development for therapists, psychologists, and holistic practitioners.

Natalia Maganda provides comprehensive digital services for mental health professionals and wellness practitioners, with a focus on HIPAA compliance, local SEO optimization, and conversion-focused website design. The site includes educational resources, case studies, and a podcast for private practice growth.

## Key Topics

- Private practice marketing
- Therapist websites
- SEO services
- Google Ads management
- HIPAA compliance
- Lead generation
- Conversion optimization
- Web design for therapists
- Local SEO
- WordPress alternatives
- Squarespace compliance
- Client acquisition
- Holistic practitioners
- Website design
- Mental health professionals

- [Web Design for Therapists & Private Practice | SEO Services](https://www.nataliamaganda.com/web-design-for-therapists-and-practitioners): Main service page for custom web design and local SEO services for therapists and private practices.
- [SEO Services for Therapists and Private Practices | Local SEO agency](https://www.nataliamaganda.com/seo-for-therapists-and-private-practice): Local SEO service page with Local SEO Launch Package for therapists and private practices.
- [Google Ads Management for Therapists | Campaign Management Agency](https://www.nataliamaganda.com/google-ads-for-therapists): Google Ads management service page for therapists with HIPAA compliance and campaign strategies.
